title: Law to expand rent freeze outreach to disability program
summary: This bill would add the Disability Rent Increase Exemption program and the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities to the city's existing rent freeze information-sharing requirements. It would require the Department of Finance to provide annual training, starting by June 30, 2027, to participating agency staff on eligibility, applications, accommodations and referrals for rent freeze programs. The department would also have to report annually to the Council on these trainings starting October 1, 2027.
